name: geo-agent-platform
//: Python worker only hosts packages/gis-meteorology scientific execution.

scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/operations
scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.build:operations: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace apps/operations
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace apps/web && npm run test --workspace apps/operations
scripts.test:server: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace server
scripts.test:web: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace apps/web
